subject: Case study draft: LumosAnalytics x Redwood Inference — draft for review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dana Cruz <dana.cruz@lumosanalytics.com>, Sam Price <sam.price@lumosanalytics.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Case study draft: LumosAnalytics x Redwood Inference — draft for review

Hi Dana / Sam —

Thanks again for the sit-down last week. Attached is the first draft of the case study we discussed (lumos-redwood-case-study-v1.docx). Key areas we focused on: the inference cost reduction, the throughput gains after switching to Redwood Dedicated, and the integration timeline.

Could you please:
- Fact-check the bullets under "Results" (we pulled the numbers from your Q2 report)
- Confirm the attribution and exact quote from your Head of Data (we tentatively used the line below)
- Flag any phrasing you want changed for compliance/pricing sensitivity

Suggested turnaround: 5 business days, but happy to adjust. If easier, feel free to send a redlined doc back — we can iterate.

Proposed quote (tentative): "Redwood shortened our model response times by 3x while lowering per-token cost by ~40% — enabling faster product experiments."

Attachments: lumos-redwood-case-study-v1.docx (draft)

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Dana Cruz <dana.cruz@lumosanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Case study draft: LumosAnalytics x Redwood Inference — draft for review

Marissa —

Thanks for the draft. Sam and I went through it and left inline redlines (attached: lumos-redlines-v1.docx). High-level notes:
- Please change the uptime claim — we don't publish exact SLA numbers; can you swap "99.99% uptime" to "improved platform reliability"?
- The cost reductions look right directionally but the 40% figure is our internal estimate for a single workload. Can we change to a range ("~30–45% on typical batch workloads") or attribute as "customer-reported"?
- I rewrote the quote to be a bit more conservative and added a short tagline from our Head of Data (see the redline).
- We need to keep any mention of sensitive PII/PHI workflows out. The paragraph on "PHI processing" should be removed.

We can also hop on a 20-min call if you want to walk the edits together.

Attachment: lumos-redlines-v1.docx

Thanks,
Dana Cruz
VP, Platform Engineering
LumosAnalytics
dana.cruz@lumosanalytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Dana Cruz <dana.cruz@lumosanalytics.com>, Sam Price <sam.price@lumosanalytics.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study draft: LumosAnalytics x Redwood Inference — draft for review

Dana — great, thank you for the detailed redlines. Appreciate the conservative framing.

I incorporated your changes into v2 (attached: lumos-redwood-case-study-v2.docx) and included a one-page redline summary (redline-summary.pdf) showing where we adjusted metrics and removed the PHI paragraph. Notes for internal reviewers:
- Priyom: legal check — can we accept the customer-provided 30–45% range as an unverified customer metric and include the attribution line "customer-reported"?
- Michael: tech check — we swapped the specific SLA language for "improved platform reliability". Confirm the revised phrasing is accurate given the Dedicated rollout timeline.
- Lauren: marketing — once Dana signs off publicly, do we need to route the final to brand for logo assets? Dana indicated they prefer anonymized assets; see bottom of email.

If you (Dana/Sam) want a quick call to confirm the final quote language, I'm available 10:30–11:30 PT today.

Attachments: lumos-redwood-case-study-v2.docx, redline-summary.pdf

Best,
Marissa
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Case study draft: LumosAnalytics x Redwood Inference — draft for review

Quick legal check: the edits look fine. Recommendation: accept the customer-provided range and add the phrase "as reported by LumosAnalytics" after the statistic. Remove any sentence that implies Redwood independently audited PHI handling; the customer can speak to their own compliance posture.

I approve the redlines for publication pending final written approval from Dana (signed-approval.pdf).

-Priyom
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Dana Cruz <dana.cruz@lumosanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sam Price <sam.price@lumosanalytics.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Case study draft: LumosAnalytics x Redwood Inference — FINAL APPROVAL

Marissa —

We've signed off. Confirmed: use the 30–45% range with "as reported by LumosAnalytics" attribution; replace SLA sentence with "improved platform reliability"; remove PHI paragraph.

One additional constraint: we prefer the case study be published as an anonymized customer story (no LumosAnalytics logo, no product names beyond what is already in the draft). We attached a signed approval (signed-approval.pdf).

You have permission to publish the anonymized case study on Redwood's marketing site and in sales collateral once the final document reflects these items. Please send a quick confirmation when live.

Thanks for the partnership — happy to be a reference (please ask first on scheduling).

Best,
Dana Cruz
VP, Platform Engineering
LumosAnalytics
Attachment: signed-approval.pdf
